newsitem.title: USA: Unibanco unit offering filed at US SEC.
newsitem.headline: Unibanco unit offering filed at US SEC.

text.p: Unibanco Holdings SA and Unibanco - Uniao De Bancos Brasileiros SA, Brazil's third largest private-sector bank, filed Thursday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up to 23,792,451 global depositary shares, each representing 500 units of preferred shares.

Neither company will receive any proceeds from the sale since all of the units are being sold by Banco National SA, a financial institution organized under the laws of Brazil, according to the regulatory filing.
Each unit will consist of one preferred share of Unibanco -Uniao de Bancos Brazileiros SA and one Class B preferred share of Unibanco Holdings, the bank's controlling shareholder.
The global depositary share offering is one of three concurrent offerings that total 15,861,634,025 units, according to the SEC filing.
Global coordinators for the offerings are Lehman Brothers, J.P. Morgan & Co, Morgan Stanley & Co and SBC Warburg Inc.
The global depositary share offering filed with the SEC will be underwritten by Morgan Stanley & Co, Lehman Brothers, JP Morgan & Co and SBC Warburg Inc.
